name: Low-cost Opentrons OT-2 pipeline for high-throughput enzyme expression and purification (Sci. Rep. 2024)
brief: A semi-automated protein production pipeline: one benchtop liquid-handling robot with magnetic module and common biochemistry equipment (shaker-incubator, centrifuge) transforms E. coli, inoculates cultures, lyses cells and does Ni-bead purification with protease elution, producing 96 purified enzymes in parallel, scalable to hundreds of proteins per week per user.

cost.original: ~ $20,000-30,000 USD for the OT-2 robot equipped with pipettes and accessory modules (at the time of writing, 2024)
cost.excludes_note: Robot with pipettes and modules only; shakers, centrifuge, plates, reagents and gene synthesis (the costliest step) excluded. Midpoint used for value_usd.

reported.throughput_unit: proteins per batch (hundreds per week per user)

notes: Single-instrument price check: the reported figure is one OT-2 with pipettes/modules, so this tests the catalog price band, not whole-lab design. includes covers 'instruments' because the catalog files liquid handlers there. Verified 3 Oct 2026 via Europe PMC full text (PMC11196671): "the OT-2 from Opentrons costs ~ $20,000-30,000 USD (at the time of writing) for the robot equipped with pipettes and accessory modules." Same text: Hamilton/Tecan systems "> $150,000 USD"; KingFisher ~$80,000. This is a robot price quoted for context, not a total-lab figure, so use as a lower-bound sanity check.

equipment.rationale: The single OT-2 the paper prices.
